site.about: {software} applications for Windows, Linux and Android, and {games} games: Dofus Retro classics reimagined, a Paper Mario Tetris and a rhythm game that charts your own music. Every one of them is free, works without an account, sends no telemetry, and is published on GitHub with its releases.
legal: Retro Defenders, Retro Survivors and Retro Chess are non-commercial fan projects, not affiliated with or endorsed by Ankama. Dofus and Dofus Retro are trademarks of Ankama.
Paper Tetris is a non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo or The Tetris Company. Paper Mario is a trademark of Nintendo; Tetris is a trademark of The Tetris Company.

projects.name: Chud Music
projects.tagline: The desktop music player, modern and retro.
projects.description: Your files, YouTube Music without an account, radio from all over the world and synced lyrics, in one app. Five skins, a Milkdrop visualizer, a ten-band equalizer, and a library that stays fast across thousands of tracks. Your files are never modified or deleted.

projects.name: Chud Music for Android
projects.tagline: One player for your phone, your NAS, YouTube Music and the radio.
projects.description: Plays the music on your phone, on SMB and WebDAV shares streamed straight from your PC or NAS, YouTube Music without ads or a Google account, and thousands of Internet stations. Playlists travel both ways with the desktop app. Free software under the GPL.

projects.name: Chud IPTV
projects.tagline: A simple, fast and private IPTV player for your own playlists.
projects.description: Imports M3U playlists and Xtream Codes accounts, shows a TV guide with what is on now, keeps movies and episodes for offline viewing, and survives dropped connections without leaving full screen. It provides no channels: bring your own sources. Everything stays on your device.

projects.name: Chud Image
projects.tagline: A small, fast photo viewer. The heir of Windows 7 Photo Viewer.
projects.description: Double-click a picture, it opens instantly. Flick through the folder, zoom to the cursor, rotate JPEGs losslessly, print with a real preview. A light editor handles crop, adjustments, drawing, text and offline background removal. No library to import, no account, no cloud.

projects.name: Chud Copy
projects.tagline: Set up your copy and sync jobs once. Run them when you decide.
projects.description: A local, manual backup tool built on a real sync engine, with a visual map of your folders and a preview of every change before it happens. Nothing runs without you: no cloud account, no background service, no schedule. Comes with integrity checks, disk health, duplicates, a NAS tester and a drive identity guard.

projects.name: Chud Clone
projects.tagline: Disk cloning and diagnostics for Windows, verified every time.
projects.description: Copies a disk to another disk or to an image file, checks that the copy is identical with BLAKE3 read-back, and tells you plainly whether the result can be trusted. Grows the Windows partition onto a larger disk, reads SMART health over time, scans surfaces for slow or unreadable areas, and ships a WinPE rescue ISO.

projects.name: Chud Converter
projects.tagline: The universal file converter that tells you what will be lost.
projects.description: It detects what your files really are, picks the conversion path that loses the least, lists beforehand everything that will go away, then reads the result back to verify it. Video, audio, images, documents, e-books, archives, PDF and OCR, all on your machine. Your originals are never touched.

projects.name: Chud Input Recorder
projects.tagline: Record, edit, automate and replay your keyboard, mouse and gamepads.
projects.description: A macro studio rather than a big red button. Every take lands on a real timeline, one lane per key and button, that you can zoom, drag and trim without ever losing the original. Stack visual blocks to repeat, branch and wait for an image, a colour or a piece of text on screen. It shows when it is recording, has an emergency stop that always works, and nothing ever leaves your computer.

projects.name: Retro Defenders
projects.tagline: A tower defense set in the world of Dofus Retro.
projects.description: The twelve classes are your towers, the monsters come from their real regions, and every upgrade changes your character's outfit. An 18-map campaign across Amakna, Astrub, Sidimote and Pandala, map interactions, a bestiary, an Ultimate Mode, and full gamepad and touch support. Play in your browser or download it.

projects.name: Retro Survivors
projects.tagline: Survive ten minutes in the World of Twelve.
projects.description: A free Vampire Survivors-like built from the art, sounds and monsters of Dofus Retro. Pick a class, pick a zone, hold out for ten minutes against ever-growing waves, choose an upgrade at every level and come back with your kamas. 16 classes, 20 zones, 234 monsters, spell fusions, relics, a daily challenge and a thousand cosmetics.

projects.name: Retro Chess
projects.tagline: Chess with living pieces, in the world of Dofus Retro.
projects.description: Every piece is a creature that walks to its square, fights for every capture and falls on illustrated boards. Follow the Champions' Path against ten opponents from 450 to 1900 Elo, then play freely from 400 to 2800 Elo, or face a friend on the same screen. Stockfish runs inside the game on every platform, the browser included.

projects.name: Paper Tetris
projects.tagline: Classic Tetris, folded into a Paper Mario 64 storybook.
projects.description: Strict modern Tetris with SRS rotation, hold, T-Spins and five modes, played on nine Paper Mario battle stages rebuilt in 3D. A troupe of Shy Guys dances when you score a Tetris and panics when the stack gets high, Bowser watches you in his castle, and the original soundtrack plays throughout. Play in your browser or download it.

projects.name: Chud Tiles
projects.tagline: A rhythm game that writes its charts from your music.
projects.description: Notes slide down glowing lanes toward a hit line: press the lane when they touch it. Nobody charts the songs by hand: Chud Tiles listens to each track, local files or YouTube Music, and builds a playable chart for every difficulty, from Easy to Expert on 3 to 7 lanes. Combos set the lanes on fire, scores go to an online leaderboard, all under procedural space scenes.
